text: Hide-And-Seek on a Holy Night
First, go with Velly, the little girl you met in the forest,\nto her house to look for the reindeer that is supposed to\ncome meet her!
Since the reindeer wasn't in Velly's house, he might be in\nJoulu House, the factory where the presents are made.\nHead there!
Save Dunder the reindeer who was held captive by Shawle the\nanti Xmas energy in Joulu House! Try to find the center of\nthe house first!
Find and rescue Dunder whom Shawle has hidden once again!\nTry finding him by heading northwest!
Dunder was on the top of the locomotive, but Shawle hid him\nagain. Try finding him by heading southeast this time!
You found Dunder, but Shawle hid him again. Try going to\nthe back of the center part since you've not seen him there!
Shawle is waiting in the back room, but the door is sealed\nwith anti Xmas energy. Let's collect Sacred Candles to\nbreak the seal!
Defeat Shawle to get Dunder back!
In order to get ready to give out presents to Navida City,
defeat Shawle who exudes the full power of anti Xmas energy\nand let's deliver the presents to Navida City!
